analyst_view.overall: Union Saint-Gilloise are 4th in the Europa League with 10 points, unbeaten in 16 games in all competitions and top in Belgium; they host this game at Den Dreef in Leuven. Lech Poznan lead the Polish league but have 1 point from four European games (2 scored, 12 conceded) and need a win. This morning's checks found no new absences: Lech travelled with Sayyadmanesh back in full training and new keeper Johnsson, while Pablo Rodriguez stays in Spain for rehab and captain Ishak is still training only on his own; one squad-news page still lists Sayyadmanesh with a groin problem, so his minutes are uncertain. Union have Sylla and Kricfalusi back in training but miss Havenaar, Mac Allister and Biondic (all counted) plus reserve keeper Chambaere. Spanish referee Jose Maria Sanchez Martinez's card record is already in the numbers, so with nothing new pointing either way I keep the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals, 2.5 for Union, with Biondic's absence already taken off and Havenaar's added for Lech. Lech's attack has played without Ishak and Pablo Rodriguez for weeks, which their recent scoring already shows, and Sayyadmanesh's return is offset by doubts over his fitness, so I stay at about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.3 corners, already trimming Union for their low recent corner count (-7.5%). Lech are expected to sit in a cautious 4-2-3-1 and are short of wide players with Walemark out, but their small share (3.1) already reflects that, so I stay at about 8.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, adding about 20% for referee Sanchez Martinez's record and lowering for both sides' calm recent games. Lech need points but are a passing side, Union control games, and a modest crowd at Den Dreef adds little heat, so I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers expect 30.9 shots, with Union expected to dominate (21.5). Both clubs play league games three days later and some rotation is possible, but Lech's line-up has barely changed lately and Union get Sylla back, so the one-sided game the numbers assume still fits and I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.7 shots on target, already adding for Union's accurate recent shooting (+11.2%). Lech's blunt attack without Ishak and Pablo Rodriguez is what their recent games already show, and Kevin Rodriguez is expected to lead Union's line as usual, so I stay at about 11.7.
